description: Pad text on the left to a target character count. Missing or null text uses empty text, missing or null length uses zero, and the first character of pad_char is repeated. Missing, null, or empty pad characters use a space. Values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to pad. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Target character count from 0 to 65536 inclusive. Missing or null input uses zero. A value of zero leaves the text unchanged. All values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: pad_char
inputs.description: Character to repeat. Only the first character is used. Missing, null, or empty input uses a space.

outputs.name: padded
outputs.description: Text padded on the left to the target character count, or the original text when it is already long enough.

description: Pad text on the right to a target character count. Missing or null text uses empty text, missing or null length uses zero, and the first character of pad_char is repeated. Missing, null, or empty pad characters use a space. Values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to pad. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Target character count from 0 to 65536 inclusive. Missing or null input uses zero. A value of zero leaves the text unchanged. All values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: pad_char
inputs.description: Character to repeat. Only the first character is used. Missing, null, or empty input uses a space.

outputs.name: padded
outputs.description: Text padded on the right to the target character count, or the original text when it is already long enough.

description: Limit text to a target character count. Missing or null text uses empty text, missing or null length uses zero. Zero leaves text unchanged, and an ellipsis is added only when requested with a target length greater than three. Values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to limit. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Maximum character count from 0 to 65536 inclusive. Missing or null input uses zero. A value of zero leaves the text unchanged. All values outside 0 through 65536 fail before output.

inputs.name: add_ellipsis
inputs.description: Whether to append three dots when truncating. Missing or null input uses false. Ellipsis is applied only when the target length is greater than three.

outputs.name: truncated
outputs.description: Text limited to the target character count, with an ellipsis when requested and the target length allows it.
